lines: Deceit there not to be done; and having done that downwards should go the disciple. Not again should proclaim of him sin; the proclaimer should go.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śāṭhyaṃ tatra na kāryaṃ ca tatkṛtvādho vrajecchiśuḥ na punaḥ kīrtayettasya pāpaṃ kīrtayitā vrajet
